patterns.block_scope_state_reset: R63 #aw_sg63a1 bufferresetbeforereuse: a write/read/reset state machine re-initialized fresh PER *ast.BlockStmt (analyzeStraightLineBlock's written/read maps), combined with collectEvents refusing to descend into If/For/Range/Switch/TypeSwitch/Select, means state never carries from an outer block into a nested control-flow block. A write+read in the outer scope followed by a reuse-write inside a nested if/for is invisible - the inner block's isolated event list sees only a first-ever write. PROBE any linter/analyzer that (a) walks every BlockStmt via ast.Inspect calling a per-block analysis function, AND (b) has that per-block function refuse to descend into sibling control-flow bodies - the two together silently sever state that should span the whole function.
